about: C18: piso cero at its real levels, built for Codex's request docs/blocks/floor0-candidate-request.md on the sources of docs/blocks/level-zones.md ("Piso cero"). Floors 0 and 1 are built: floor 1 is the C16 floor 1 with its Site ground slab opened under the stair wells. Floors 3, 4, 5 are the C16 GLBs and floor 2 the C17 GLB, unchanged, for the checks. Block A and the east clinic go to N -4.13 (local -1.19 from the B datum, world -0.63). The west and pending parts stay at N -2.94 (local 0). The east tower is rebuilt with a 3.50 m rise to C16 floor 1.

a_polys.note: Waiting room, halls and clinic east of the drawn flights. West edge: the waiting-room wall at x 36.3 and the west-stair foot at x 37.85. B stair: the foot at x 38.6, the bodega wall at x 39.25. South edge: the hall's diagonal walls and the glass at y 34.3. Rooms south of it are pending and stay at 0
